issues: Changed factor 'baseline vs 4' is unsupported by visible context.
Primary comparison should be lot test CD IR250410013 vs Normal if using report rows.
Outcome grouping mixes row numbers or sample IDs as conditions.
Report!21 and Tension!10/12 are not supported by provided context text.
Spec 1.2kgf is cited in title but omitted from tension stats.
correctionPlan: Replace changed factor with test CD lot IR250410013 versus Normal, unless hidden rows prove another factor.
Use Report!19 and Report!25 for NG rate and function/separation comparison.
Use Tension!8 as the cited tension result for the test lot and include spec 1.2kgf.
Do not treat numeric row/sample identifiers such as 4 or 7 as changed conditions.
Remove or validate hidden-row citations before approval.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist syntactically, but cited row context is insufficient and grouping citations are not reliable.
